name: William W Sloan — a wife named Maria on an 1891 Toronto marriage of a son Thomas John Sloane
researcher_question: Besides Agnes McCaa, did William W Sloan (born 22 July 1832 in Ontario, died 25 December 1921 in Toronto, buried at Blyth, Huron County) have another wife, and if so, who was she?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-4.csv row 4, hint-samples.csv row 129, flags adds_spouse, confidence 3). Draft transcribed from an 1891 Toronto civil marriage registration of a Thomas John Sloane, age 30, naming his parents as William and Maria Sloane; unverified. The tree's wife is Agnes McCaa and its two sons Thomas were born 1859 (died 1861) and 1865, so a different William Sloane family is the likely reading.
